name: iMessage Photon
description: Message a Paperclip agent from Apple Messages using Photon Cloud. Pro supports DMs; dedicated lines also support groups.

methods.label: Chat with an agent
methods.whenToUse: Let people in iMessage Photon start and continue work with one Paperclip agent.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect a Photon Cloud project. Pro shared lines support DMs after sender enrollment in Photon and identity linking in Paperclip. Dedicated lines also support individually enabled groups.
